chapter.title: Storage Network
subtitle: One list for every chest in the valley.
Certus in the stone, four presses under a crater, and a screen that ends rummaging.

hover: Pale blue buds in ordinary stone.
Sixteen is a floor, not a target.

images.hover: Halden's spring, or the mod's own recipe.
Three things thrown in standing water.
It only ever arrives by meteorite.
It builds the dull parts while you walk.

quests.title: Mine Sixteen Certus Quartz
quests.subtitle: Pale blue buds in ordinary stone.
description: A storage network is one list: every chest, drawer and barrel on it shows on a single screen, searchable, pulled out by name.
Mine sixteen &aCertus Quartz Crystals&r. They grow as pale blue buds in stone, most often near caves and water.

quests.title: Smelt Eight Silicon
quests.subtitle: Dust first. The furnace does the rest.
description: Grind certus to &aCertus Quartz Dust&r in a Millstone or a Pulverizer, then smelt the dust into &aSilicon&r.
Every processor you print starts here. The millstone is in the &6Create&r chapter.

quests.title: Cut a Certus Knife and Wrench
quests.subtitle: One cuts patterns, one turns cables.
description: Craft a &aCertus Quartz Cutting Knife&r and a &aCertus Quartz Wrench&r.
The knife cuts blank patterns and names things. The wrench turns and pulls network parts without breaking them.

quests.title: Build a Charger and Power It
quests.subtitle: Halden's spring, or the mod's recipe.
description: Halden: "She kept a jar of the blue stuff on my shelf four years and never once said what it was for."
Craft a &aCharger&r and run any FE into it. Two recipes work: the mod's own, and the valley's, which wants a bottle of &bSpring Water&r.

quests.title: Charge Eight Certus Crystals
quests.subtitle: One at a time, on the charger's face.
description: Drop or right-click &aCertus Quartz Crystals&r onto a powered Charger and wait.
&bCharged certus&r is the one ingredient nothing substitutes. A hopper above the charger does this while you work.

quests.title: Grow Sixteen Fluix in Water
quests.subtitle: Throw three things in. Walk away.
description: Throw &acharged certus&r, redstone and nether quartz into standing water. They fuse into &aFluix Crystals&r on their own.
Fluix is in every cable, every cell and the controller. Sixteen is a floor, not a target.

quests.title: Stack Four Growth Accelerators
quests.subtitle: Budding quartz, hurried along.
description: Craft four &aCrystal Growth Accelerators&r, set them against a budding quartz block and run power in.
Buds ripen in seconds instead of hours. The valley's recipe wants &bSpring Water&r; the mod's own does not.

quests.title: Walk the Compass to the Crater
quests.subtitle: Nearest one: x -216, z 72.
description: Charge a plain &aCompass&r in the Charger for a &aMeteorite Compass&r, then hold it and walk until it points straight down.
The nearest crater is 110 blocks east of the farm hearth, at &bx -216, z 72&r. Dig where the needle drops.

quests.title: Build With Sixteen Sky Stone
quests.subtitle: It only ever arrives by meteorite.
description: Smelt crater rock into &aSmooth Sky Stone&r and build a &aSky Stone Chest&r out of the plain blocks.
Sky stone shrugs off a creeper, which makes sixteen blocks a decent wall around a drive.

quests.title: Empty the Chest of Four Presses
quests.subtitle: Not craftable. Found, once, in a hole.
description: Dig under the crater and open the &aSky Stone Chest&r buried inside it. It holds one of each &aInscriber Press&r.
Four presses, one crater. A press copies itself in an Inscriber over an iron block, so never lose all four.

quests.title: Build an Inscriber
quests.subtitle: Iron, copper and two sticky pistons.
description: Craft an &aInscriber&r. It takes a press on top, a press underneath and the material in the middle.
It does nothing at all until the presses are out of the crater.

quests.title: Print Eight of Each Processor
quests.subtitle: Two passes each: print, then press.
description: Inscribe &aPrinted Silicon&r and a printed circuit, then run the pair through again with redstone between them.
Eight logic, eight calculation, eight engineering. A belt feeding the &aInscriber&r does all of it for you.

quests.title: Set One ME Controller Down
quests.subtitle: Everything hangs off its six faces.
description: Craft an &aME Controller&r and run &aFluix Glass Cable&r out of its faces. Every device those cables touch joins one network.
One is plenty. Two controller blocks touching are one machine, not two networks.

quests.title: Count the Channels
quests.subtitle: Eight per cable, thirty-two per dense.
description: Every device that stores, sorts or shows something eats one &bchannel&r. A glass cable carries eight, a dense cable thirty-two.
Hold the &aNetwork Tool&r and look at a cable to read what is left. A device out of channels goes red; nothing is broken.

quests.title: Feed the Network FE
quests.subtitle: An acceptor turns FE into AE.
description: Put an &aEnergy Acceptor&r on the network and run an energy duct into it. Set an &aEnergy Cell&r beside it to cover the spikes.
Where the FE comes from is the &6Thermal&r chapter.

quests.title: Rack an ME Drive and a 1k Cell
quests.subtitle: The drive is the shelf, cells the disks.
description: Craft an &aME Drive&r and one &a1k Item Storage Cell&r, slot the cell in and put the drive on the cable.
That is the moment the network has somewhere to put things. Cells pull out and travel in a pocket.

quests.title: Cut a 4k and a 16k Cell
quests.subtitle: Types cost more than counts do.
description: Craft a &a4k&r and a &a16k Item Storage Cell&r.
A cell's number is bytes, not stacks, and every new item type costs bytes before it holds one. Few types, deep stacks.

quests.title: Hang an ME Terminal on a Cable
quests.subtitle: One screen and one search box.
description: Craft an &aME Terminal&r, put it on the side of a cable and open it. Everything in every cell shows up in one searchable list.
The &aCrafting Terminal&r is the same screen with a 3x3 grid. Act III, step 51 builds this one in the mill workshop.

quests.title: Bus the Drawers Onto the Network
quests.subtitle: Import in, export out, storage both.
description: Craft an &aImport Bus&r, an &aExport Bus&r and a &aStorage Bus&r.
A Storage Bus on a drawer controller puts the whole wall on the terminal without moving one item. Act III, step 52 does that to the granary.

quests.title: Carry the Terminal in a Pocket
quests.subtitle: Range is boosters, not optimism.
description: Craft a &aWireless Access Point&r for the cable and a &aWireless Terminal&r for yourself, then charge the terminal at the point.
Each &aWireless Booster&r inside the access point widens the range. Act V, step 84 covers the whole town this way.

quests.title: Stack a Crafting CPU
quests.subtitle: Four units, a storage, an assembler.
description: Stack four &aCrafting Units&r, one &a1k Crafting Storage&r and a &aMolecular Assembler&r into one solid group on the network.
That group is what runs a crafting job. Act IV, step 68 builds it so the reactor's dull parts build themselves.

quests.title: Encode Eight Patterns
quests.subtitle: Then ask the terminal for the thing.
description: Craft a &aPattern Encoding Terminal&r, two &aPattern Providers&r and eight &aBlank Patterns&r.
Encode a recipe, drop the pattern in a provider, set the provider against a machine, then ask the terminal for the result.

rewards.title: Storage Network
rewards.description: Next: Act V, step 84a encodes eight of these and wires Marnie's pantry to the network.
